claims.claim: The asset matches the requested source identity, fixture kind, chair shape and approximate dimensions.
claims.evidence: asset/provenance.json identifies furniture/guest_chair_1, class furniture; asset/asset.json and readings.json declare fixture. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png and iso.png show a neutral chair with a seat, four legs and curved back. probes/02_geometry.out measures 0.60900002 x 0.54548529 x 0.86589351 m, matching the requested approximately 0.609 x 0.546 x 0.866 m.

claims.claim: Named collision boxes cover the visible chair and preserve the accessible seat and under-seat spaces.
claims.evidence: probes/02_geometry.out: 128 boxes, including 99 curved-back patches; zero uncovered vertices among 16,517 and zero uncovered face centers among 13,778 at 0.00001 m tolerance. Collision and visual overall bounds agree within 0.000001 m; readings bounds agree with URDF within 0.000050 m. Renders and readings.json show separate seat, legs, segmented back and decorative details. At y=0, z=0.65 m the back box spans x=0.20113..0.26939 m, leaving the seat-side opening clear. probes/01_fixture.out: a 4 cm cube dropped at (0.12,0,0.65) passes through that opening to rest at z=0.46674 m on the seat; a cube below the seat falls to ground center z=0.01997 m.

claims.claim: The fixed chair blocks test objects at its seat and back and remains fixed upright.
claims.evidence: probes/01_fixture.out: after 150 total frames (5 s), the seat cube center is z=0.46676 m (seat top approximately 0.4468 m), and the back cube center is z=0.88330 m. Both retain their positions from frame 30. Each supported cube has four approximately 0.245 N contacts with body. The body stays at [0,0,0] with identity rotation.

claims.claim: Joint travel, moving-part support and inter-link interference checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: The request requires no joints. readings.json joints is []; probes/02_geometry.out confirms one body link and zero URDF joints; probes/01_fixture.out reports joints {}. There are no distinct moving links to interpenetrate.

claims.claim: Handle grasp and pull checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no handles; readings.json handles is []. The decorative back ring is not a declared manipulation handle.

claims.claim: Place-target settling and rim checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no place targets; readings.json place_targets is []. Supplemental seat and back collision tests are recorded in probes/01_fixture.out.

claims.claim: Free-body upright settling is not required for this fixed fixture.
claims.evidence: request.md explicitly specifies a fixture loaded fixed on the floor, consistent with asset/asset.json and readings.json kind=fixture. REVIEW.md applies free-body settling to rigid objects. Fixed upright behavior was verified in probes/01_fixture.out.
